basic_info.description: Perfectly positioned on the coveted North Slope of Bernal Heights, 62 Aztec presents a rare blend of timeless sophistication, flexibility, and iconic San Francisco views. Set near the end of a tranquil non-through street, this residence showcases sweeping panorama views across the San Francisco skyline and Bay. Behind its understated exterior lies a spacious home designed to meet the demands of modern living. Featuring 3 bedrooms plus a flexible studio level, 2 bathrooms, abundant storage, and a 4-car garage, the property offers functional spaces including a laundry room, an office nook and a private back patio ideal for entertaining or unwinding. Expansive windows fill the interiors with natural light, highlighting dramatic outlooks from both the living room and the spacious primary bedroom. Situated at the end of Aztec street are the Aztec Steps which provide convenient access to local amenities including Charlie's Cafe, Precita Park Cafe & Grill, the green space of Precita Park and the scenic trails of Bernal Hill. Commuters will be pleased to find the 101 and 280 freeways easily accessed at either end of Bernal Heights. Available for the first time in 100 years, 62 Aztec is a rare opportunity to claim a trophy residence for generations to come.
